WITH a AS (
  SELECT client_id, MAX(date_start) AS d FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.raw.raw_meta_adset_insights`
  WHERE date_start >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 40 DAY) GROUP BY client_id
), dm AS (
  SELECT client_id, MAX(date_start) AS d FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.raw.raw_meta_ad_breakdown_demo`
  WHERE date_start >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 40 DAY) GROUP BY client_id
), pl AS (
  SELECT client_id, MAX(date_start) AS d FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.raw.raw_meta_ad_breakdown_placement`
  WHERE date_start >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 40 DAY) GROUP BY client_id
)
SELECT c.client_id, c.slug,
  CAST(a.d AS STRING) AS adset_max,
  CAST(dm.d AS STRING) AS demo_max,
  CAST(pl.d AS STRING) AS placement_max
FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.ref.clients` c
LEFT JOIN a ON a.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN dm ON dm.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN pl ON pl.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.has_meta = TRUE
ORDER BY c.client_id

parameters.content:
## wf_meta_adsets_breakdowns_to_bigquery
Loads raw.raw_meta_adset_insights, raw.raw_meta_ad_breakdown_demo (age x gender) and raw.raw_meta_ad_breakdown_placement.
Hourly at :35 UTC: ad sets D-3..D-1. Breakdowns D-3..D-1 at 03, 07, 11, 15, 19, 23 UTC. 03 UTC catch-up: ad sets 35 days, breakdowns 14 days (backfill 90 / 35 days when a client has no rows). Manual run = catch-up.
No attribution window parameter: same per ad set setting as the legacy ad-level columns.
Replaces the never-imported infra/n8n/wf_meta_creative_nightly.json.
